minimal_diagnostic_seam.capture: After the original alias returns, read only the identity-bound original review_raw_hook_native caller code/line and closed harness/event values. No global tracing or profiling. A constant map distinguishes the seven original terminal return sites without touching raw payloads or response text.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.same_context_code: Only at the exact resident_client_returned_none site, read native_resident_client_failure_code in the original worker context. The original native_resident_client_request resets that ContextVar at entry (line267); no stale code is attributed to other branches. A null/unknown code remains unknown/incomplete, never inferred from parent context.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.binding: Verify exact current source bytes and a closed recursive structural image of selected live code, caller identity and fixed line map before attaching. Refuse changed/rebound code and restore only owned alias. Source/global graph scope must be explicit.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.privacy: No source text, command, payload, arbitrary exception message, output, path, token, request bytes or raw frame locals are exported. Only finite site/harness/event/route labels and admitted native scalar code.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.loss: Finite rows, sticky recording loss/overflow/restoration failure; unknown or unbound site remains incomplete. Forward original behavior even when observation fails.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.budget: No extra product request, status query, OS call, clock sample, poll, wait, warmup, retry or deadline adjustment in caller paths. Post-original recording has explicit diagnostic overhead.
minimal_diagnostic_seam.scope: Attach to a separately necessary original qualification after substantive source/control/operational peer and exact artifact/build review. No blind normal rerun is proposed. The failed cbd wheel/executable cannot be reused because bytes were not uploaded; any necessary rebuilt binary must have fresh honest identity.

meaningful_controls: Each exact original seven return site exercises its own unchanged provider path and only its closed label; missing status cannot be reclassified as client failure.
Original return object and BaseException identity survive capture/getter/restoration failures.
Original client ContextVar reset and exact same-worker code are admitted; stale pre-client or other-thread values cannot become current-cause evidence.
Same-name/file code mutation, line-map drift, wrong caller, duplicate/lost/overflow record, foreign alias and unknown code all refuse complete admission.
Actual source protocol fixtures remain unchanged; no mocked control becomes original installed qualification.
limits: The observed unavailable response localizes visible delivery, not lower operation cause. All twenty successful native routes and one fallback remain a failed required21 gate.
After-delivery publisher ACK, probe-context null and empty persistence diagnostics cannot assign runtime/transport/policy/deadline cause.
This prospective seam classifies the immediate raw-edge None branch; it does not by itself prove a kernel cause, lost receipts or original historical failure reason.
